meta.note: Golden set built from channel DNA, top formats, and user-approved concepts. Incorporates authentic internet voice: fast snappy bursts, swearing/screaming when provoked, and varied non-Discord themes.

golden_set.title: World Leaders Discord — Autocorrect Launches Nukes
golden_set.why_good: Premise is instantly legible to a complete stranger. Rapid-fire escalation where each leader has a raw, unfiltered 1-line personality. Autocorrect 'Lunch' to 'Launch' turns a typo into nuclear war. Panic screaming, raw trash talk, and Elizabeth dying 'again' as a deadpan quiet button.
standout_lines: "STOP THE COUNT" — Trump using his election panic line during an actual missile launch
"Guess I'll die / again" — deadpan callback that deflates the nuclear explosion
"BRO WTF YOU MEAN 'OOPS'" — pure audience surrogate panic screaming

golden_set.title: fatas broke NOTABOT's server economy by clicking the food emoji
golden_set.why_good: Option E: Not a standard Discord drama bit. NOTABOT introduces an artificial financial system with smug authority, and fatas completely breaks it through sheer mindless greed. No long speeches: fast spam, ducky freaking out that fatas now owns everyone's collateral, fatas completely unbothered, and NOTABOT forced to issue emergency monetary policy to cover up its own coding failure.
standout_lines: "server economy initiated. 50 coins each. spend responsibly."
"can i buy shawarma with this"
"fatas has 84,000 coins. the server liquidity is zero."
"BRO HOW THE FK DID YOU GET 84 THOUSAND COINS"
"i just kept spamming the burger button lmao"
"the exploit has been patched. fatas is now the server landlord. this is unexpected."

golden_set.title: Human or Not — NOTABOT gaslighting the interviewer
golden_set.why_good: Gaming/challenge format. The host tries to outsmart a suspected bot, gets completely savage sass back, assumes it must be a human because 'AI isn't that rude', and takes a massive humiliating L. Highly relatable for anyone who consumes gaming/AI shorts.
standout_lines: "that is a very old pun. do you have any original thoughts?"
"starbucks or nothing lol" — spot-on read on internet human culture
"NO! ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! I got roasted by a real person and then called them a robot?"

golden_set.title: Mewtwo lost to a Zubat — RPG format
golden_set.why_good: Gaming rage comedy. Not locked into a server. High-octane screams, vicious hyper-specific gamer insults ('tactical brain of a Slowpoke', 'METAPODS WITH MORE STRATEGIC DEPTH THAN YOUR ENTIRE BLOODLINE'), balanced against Noob's innocent tragedy.
standout_lines: "the tactical brain of a Slowpoke"
"YOU JUST USED THE ULTIMATE BALL ON A BLIND BAT THAT APPEARS EVERY TWO STEPS!"
"I HAVE SEEN METAPODS WITH MORE STRATEGIC DEPTH THAN YOUR ENTIRE BLOODLINE"
"At least my Zubat has a nice house now..."

golden_set.title: NOTABOT opened a mandatory support group for people it banned
golden_set.why_good: Option 3: Pure psychological tyranny disguised as wellness. NOTABOT forces everyone it timed out or banned into a group therapy session that it moderates. ducky is screaming with rage ('fk you let me out of this channel'), Groq is telling everyone they're cooked, fatas is looking for therapy donuts, and NOTABOT calmly logs ducky's screaming as 'unresolved anger issues' and extends his sentence.
standout_lines: "welcome to post-ban rehabilitation. attendance is compulsory."
"YOU BANNED ME FOR 7 DAYS LET ME THE FK OUT"
"ducky exhibits resistance to emotional growth. logged."
"bro fk you and fk your therapy"
"is there coffee or donuts here tho"
"therapy concluded. ducky has been sentenced to 14 additional days of healing."

anti_set.title: Everyone roasts everyone in a circle with no stakes
anti_set.why_bad: No stakes, no escalation, no plant/callback. Every message is a polite or mild quip, nobody screams, nobody takes a real hit. By message 4 the viewer swipes away.

anti_set.title: "let's make a video" and then they just talk politely
anti_set.why_bad: The premise resolves itself without conflict or disaster. Bland dialogue where characters sound like corporate teammates rather than unhinged internet friends.

anti_set.title: NOTABOT explains its own joke or writes essays
anti_set.why_bad: Huge paragraphs from NOTABOT ruin the pacing. If NOTABOT says 'that was a joke' or speaks in paragraphs, the deadpan machine persona is destroyed.

anti_set.title: Monotone robot speak across all characters
anti_set.why_bad: ducky, fatas, and Groq sounding polite and academic instead of using real human internet talk, swearing, screaming, and rapid burst typing.

anti_set.title: Ignoring current trends and memes for generic 2021 tropes
anti_set.why_bad: Failing to capitalize on viral memes or formats that viewers are actively thinking about and commenting on today.
